messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Software and Device Operations" as it appears in the following examples.
['Our Support Division is carrying out a scheduled e-Banking software upgrade', 'Update your system through this official site if your account has been created before October 22, 2008.', 'For more additional security please click on link below to Upgrade to the service', 'This procedure is attributed to a routine banking software update.', 'Please kindly log in www.usaa.com/online/updates now to Upgrade your USA Bank account to the latest security feature.', 'Download and upgrade your application.', 'This will include all Mac computers on all campuses (including Weill, Geneva and Qatar) that are currently supported by your IT team.', 'Please ensure that your systems get updated with our new details.', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.', 'UPGRADE KASPERSKY ENDPOINT SECURITY 10 SP1 MR2 TO MR3 [WIN]', "If you haven't already installed Rapport on your home PC ...", 'Our technical service department is currently upgrading our SSL servers to enhance adequate banking security, to give our customers a better, fast and secure online banking service.', 'Please use the link below to complete your update to the new server.', 'Update your system through this official site if your account has been created before October 22, 2008.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "We perform scheduled software, security, and server upgrades, asking users to update applications and systems to maintain protection, compatibility, and reliable service."}
